paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представлява разпределение на персонажите в RoleplayPref, организирано в три основни категории. Общият брой на секторите е 13, като всеки представлява различна категория. Сеторите включват Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters, Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, Influencers и Custom Characters. Movie Characters, Comic Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters и Game Characters са в синьо, докато Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors и Influencers са в зелено. Custom Characters е в светло зелено. Визуално се забелязва, че Movie Characters е най-големият сегмент, следван от Comic Characters и Game Characters. Музикантите представляват най-големия сегмент от категорията Real Characters. Диаграмата включва легенда, идентифицираща всяка категория, а също така има етикети за всяка категория.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types within the RoleplayPref dataset. The chart is divided into thirteen categories, encompassing three broader groupings, and includes a legend labeling each segment. The largest section, representing Virtual Characters, is colored light blue and comprises approximately 60% of the total. Within Virtual Characters are five subcategories: Comic Characters (pink), Movie Characters (a darker blue), Teleplay Characters (a slightly lighter blue), Novel Characters (a muted blue), and Game Characters (a yellow-green). The Real Characters category, colored light green, is further broken down into seven segments: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians (a slightly darker green), Actors, and Influencers. Custom Characters are represented by a smaller, central segment with no further breakdown.  The slices appear to be ordered in a roughly descending order based on size, starting with Movie Characters and progressing clockwise. Percentage labels are not displayed directly on the slices.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm stellt die Verteilung von Charakteren in RoleplayPref dar, wobei verschiedene Kategorien und Unterkategorien dargestellt werden. Das Diagramm umfasst insgesamt 13 Segmente, die in drei Hauptkategorien gruppiert sind: Virtuelle Charaktere, Benutzerdefinierte Charaktere und Echte Charaktere. Der Abschnitt „Virtuelle Charaktere“ nimmt etwa 60 % der Gesamtfläche ein und ist in die Untersegmente „Comic-Charaktere“ (hellblau), „Filmfiguren“ (hellblau), „Fernsehfiguren“ (hellblau), „Romanfiguren“ (hellblau) und „Spielefiguren“ (hellblau) unterteilt. Der Abschnitt „Echte Charaktere“ umfasst die Untersegmente „Wissenschaftler“ (rosa), „Künstler“ (rosa), „Sportler“ (rosa), „Autoren“ (hellgrün), „Musiker“ (hellgrün), „Schauspieler“ (hellgrün) und „Influencer“ (hellgrün), wobei „Musiker“ das größte Segment innerhalb dieser Kategorie darstellt. Der Abschnitt „Benutzerdefinierte Charaktere“ nimmt einen kleinen Teil des Diagramms ein und hat keine zugeordneten Untersegmente. Das Diagramm enthält eine Legende und die Segmente sind in einem Umfang angeordnet, wobei die größten Segmente tendenziell nebeneinander liegen.
